newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Vilniaus Bank helps listless Lithuania bourse.
newsitem.headline: Vilniaus Bank helps listless Lithuania bourse.

text.p: Leading bank Vilniaus Bank carried the Lithuanian stock exchange by the close on Wednesday as other shares declined in listless trading.
Official list shares dipped 4.01 points to 893.15 points. The wider Group A index eased 5.86 to 1870.14 points.
Brokers expect dullish trade for the rest of July as the market awaits and then considers half-year results.

Vilniaus Bank advanced to 236 litas from 230 litas in central market turnover of 236,000 litas out of total turnover of 374,000 litas from 517,000 litas. Block trading was sleepy at 124,000 litas from 3.2 million litas.
"It was a surprise on the market because we saw a buying order for 1,000 shares at 236 litas," said one broker of Vilniaus Bank.
"From time to time orders like this appear on the market but I don't expect this to continue," the broker said, adding that he thought it had been a foreign investor.
In other trading, Birzhu Milk declined to nine litas from 9.19 litas on central market turnover of about 37,000 litas.
Brokers said the move was a price correction and that the shares would not drop much below nine litas in the near future.
